thread:
Nina: Quick follow-up from the partial outage this AM. TL;DR: cert concatenation bug + sub-60s public TTLs caused cache churn and cross-region retry amplification. Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/x/pm-2026

Theo: Spike 08:12 UTC, retries up ~3.5x, majority ap-east -> us-west. LB logs show TLS aborts after handshake when chain size >1.6KB.

Rohan: Proposed owners and short ETAs:
- Theo: LB header & cert parsing hardening, PR + canary by 2026-03-26 22:00 UTC
- Nina: Cert-upload validation + automated rollback job, due 2026-03-26 18:00 UTC
- Sky-netops: PMTU trace + pcap capture, due 2026-03-26 20:00 UTC
- Rohan: DNS TTL bump to 180s + provider failover playbook, due 2026-03-26 14:00 UTC

incidents-bot: Action created: INC-2026-6099 "Cert+DNS churn remediation" assigned to Nina, due 2026-03-26 18:00 UTC.

Theo: PR opened https://github.com/redwood/edge/pull/507 1 adds fallback when combined chain >1.5KB; canary on edge-2.

Sky-netops: Running mtr/tcpdump from ap-east egress; initial note: ICMP frag-needed seen for packets >1392B on hop 7. Uploading pcap to incident board.

Nina: I've scheduled a 10:00 UTC follow-up sync tomorrow. Agenda: owner status, canary results, alert thresholds, next steps. Invite sent.

Rohan: Implemented DNS change in staging and queued production cutover with 30m rollback window. Monitoring cache-hit and retry metrics.

Theo: Adding CI reproducible test: openssl s_client against a synthetic large chain and a wrk load test.

Nina: Will update the postmortem doc and tag related incidents for recurrence tracking. Thanks everyone.

incidents-bot: Thread archived to /incidents/2026/1775000000."
